name: Source candidates from job ads posted in Slack with Coresignal and Claude

parameters.content:
## Source candidates from job ads posted in Slack with Coresignal and Claude

### How it works

This workflow monitors Slack for newly posted job ads, extracts job URLs, and processes each unique ad in a loop. For each job, it retrieves job details from Coresignal, uses Claude to infer candidate search filters, searches Coresignal’s employee database, and posts a formatted candidate shortlist back to Slack. It also acknowledges each job as it enters processing.

### Setup steps

- Connect and authorize the Slack Trigger and Slack nodes with access to the source channel and the destination channel/thread where acknowledgements and shortlists should be posted.
- Configure Coresignal credentials/API access for the job search, job enrichment, employee search, and employee retrieval nodes.
- Configure the Anthropic Chat Model credentials for Claude in the AI filter extraction chain.
- Set the workflow configuration value `candidates_per_job` to control how many candidates are returned per job ad.
- Verify the Slack message format contains job URLs that the Extract Job URLs code node can parse.

### Customization

Adjust the URL extraction logic, Claude prompt/schema for search filters, Coresignal employee query builder, or Slack shortlist formatting to match different job boards, candidate criteria, and posting style.

## Capture job ads

Listens for Slack messages, sets the candidate count configuration, extracts job posting URLs, and removes duplicates so only new job ads continue.

## Iterate and acknowledge

Loops through each unique job ad and sends a nearby Slack acknowledgement that processing has started.

## Retrieve job details

Searches Coresignal for the job, selects the relevant job ID from the search response, and fetches the full job record.

## Extract candidate filters

Uses Claude with a structured output parser to convert the job details into search filters, then builds a Coresignal employee search query from those filters.

## Find matching employees

Runs the generated employee search in Coresignal, keeps the top scoring employee IDs, and retrieves the corresponding employee profiles.

## Post candidate shortlist

Formats the retrieved profiles into a Slack-friendly shortlist and posts it back to Slack before returning control to the job loop for the next ad.
